activation_requirements: Every participant is a confirmed adult with current informed and free consent/capacity.
The validated SequencePlan activates this fragment's family and craft axis.
craft_text:
## Voice and tension

Distribute short, character-specific vocal or verbal reactions across changing
action. Do not group all vocality into one paragraph.

Use rises, partial recovery, renewed pressure, stillness or silence, a consequential
hinge, and aftershock when the established scene supports that arc.
prohibited_inferences: Craft material cannot establish an event, preference, experience, consent, climax, injury, pregnancy, relationship fact, or character identity.
Bodily response, vocalization, silence, freezing, or compliance cannot establish desire, pleasure, or consent.
Conditional examples cannot be copied as a script or promoted to scene truth.
